name: Grace
source:
Sister Grace is an undercover member of a secret society aimed at stamping out the demonic presence in the world. She has been deployed to Vesper to hunt down and destroy the evil that has infected the city and any that may be bound to said evil.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
